auth_status.description:
HTTP status the login endpoint returns; 401 = the miner needs credentials
the widget doesn't have, so it never authenticates (the no-creds case).

chip_type.description:
Chip model each hashboard reports.
Empty reports no chip identity at all,
which drops the chip header rather than drawing placeholders.

fail_after_secs.description:
Answer 200 before this many seconds of scenario time,
then switch to `status`.
Drives the stale case: data lands, then stops refreshing.

fan_percent.description: Fan duty reported on `/cooling/state`, in percent.

hashrate_target.description:
Tuner hashrate target, in TH/s.
Absent leaves the round gauge with no sweep
to anchor, which is the un-tuned miner.

hashrate_ths.description: Current hashrate to hover around, in TH/s (low value = not-okay).

power_w.description: Power draw to hover around, in W.

temp_c.description: Junction temperature to hover around, in °C.

BosTargetRange.description:
The `{min, default, max}` triple a tuner target reports.
All three edges are required — the widget drops
the whole target when any one is missing.

payout_amount_btc.description: Amount of every completed payout, in BTC.

payout_period_s.description:
Seconds between payouts, landing on the unix-epoch grid (86400 =
daily at midnight UTC). `null` = an account that has never paid out:
no history, no estimate, null progress.

status.description: HTTP status every endpoint returns; 401/403 = the denied account.

workers_active.description: Worker counts by state, as `/user/workers/current` reports them.

avg_fees_per_block.description: Average transaction fees per block, in BTC.

block_epoch.description: Blocks mined in the current 2016-block epoch.

estimated_adjustment.description: Projected difficulty adjustment, as a fraction.

fail_after_secs.description:
Answer 200 before this many seconds of scenario time,
then switch to `status`.
Drives the stale case: data lands, then stops refreshing.

fees_percent.description: Fees as a percent of the block reward.

hash_price_currency.description: Hashprice, in the queried currency per TH/day.

history_open.description:
Price at the start of the 1d history series, which ends at `price`.
Above `price` the sparkline falls, below it climbs.

history_points.description:
Points in the history series. One point draws a widget with a series
too short to have a shape, which the chart still has to survive.

percent_change_24h.description: Price move over 24h, as a percent; negative reads red.

previous_adjustment.description: Realised difficulty adjustment, as a fraction; `0.01` means 1%.

price.description:
Bitcoin price. The `currency` query is not inspected,
so this one value answers whichever currency is asked for.

status.description: HTTP status returned after startup, or after `fail_after_secs`.

CalendarDay.description: The day the profile treats as today, e.g. 2026-08-21

Celsius.description: A temperature in degrees Celsius, above absolute zero

Formula1Params.description: Tunables for a simulated Nexus Formula 1 deployment.

careers_status.description:
Status of the careers-derived resources (the statistics table,
the driver index, the per-driver cards) — the trio the real deployment
503s while a fresh instance warms up.

careers_warmup_secs.description:
Seconds those resources 503 for before reaching `careers_status`.

A fresh deployment derives them on first boot and answers nothing
until it has — the widget's first sight of the API, and the state
it is least likely to handle.

image_dir.description:
Images the payloads point at, in a directory relative to the blueprint.
Laid out as the widget's own artwork is: `headshots/<NN>.gif`
`logos/<NN>.png` and `flags/<country>.png`, beside `circuit.png`.
Omitted, nothing is served and every image URL 404s onto the widget's placeholders.

lap_window.description:
How many laps the session runs before returning to [`Self::start_lap`].

A scenario is pinned to the lap that shows what it exists to show,
and a running clock walks away from it — a pit window closes,
a retirement becomes two. Cycling holds that state indefinitely,
at the cost of a jump on the wrap.

Omitted, the session runs to the race distance.

season_underway.description: `false` scripts the off-season: no next race, empty standings.

session.description: The running session; `idle` scripts a quiet week.

sprint.description:
Whether the weekend runs a sprint, which replaces two practices
with a sprint and a qualifying of its own.

stale_secs.description:
Added to every envelope's `cache_age_secs`;
larger than the resource's `ttl_secs` scripts stale-while-revalidate.

start_lap.description:
The lap the session is already on when the simulator starts.

Gaps, tyre ages, pit stops and retirements accumulate over a race,
so a session opened at its first lap shows a widget almost nothing.

A scenario names the lap whose state it exists to show.
Note that a race board seats only its leading rows,
so whatever sorts to the tail — a retirement, an exclusion,
a car a lap down — is visible on the full-field board alone.

time_scale.description:
How many session seconds pass per real second.

A board recomputes from completed laps, so it steps once a lap —
at `1`, every 72 s, which is one frozen frame for any real take.
Lap *times* are unscaled and still read around 1:12.

today.description:
The day the calendar is drawn around; omitted, the real one.

The weekend is the one following it,
and the debut seasons count back from its year.
